results.name: 变更端口
results.notes: Bash moves only the public Nginx port and keeps the loopback inbound on 9443; Go needs the inbound port in the same edit, so it moves that to 8444. The public port (the user-facing one) matches at 8443.

results.name: 变更UUID/映射
results.notes: Bash derives UUIDv5 from the custom mapping string; Go applies the literal UUID. Both change the client id and both ids must be valid UUIDs.

results.name: 变更target
results.goCommand: idleleo xray config edit --target www.cloudflare.com:443 --server-names www.cloudflare.com --yes --no-probe --container --json
results.notes: Bash target_set also rewrites serverNames, so the Go call sets both. Go refuses with rc=2 and writes nothing when the origin probe fails; that case is recorded BLOCKED, never PASS.
